mapper.select: SELECT report_id, report_number, report_type, CASE report_type WHEN 1 THEN '刑事案件' WHEN 2 THEN '交通事故' WHEN 3 THEN '治安案件' WHEN 4 THEN '火灾事故' WHEN 5 THEN '医疗急救' WHEN 6 THEN '民事纠纷' WHEN 99 THEN '其他' ELSE '未知' END AS report_type_name, report_level, CASE report_level WHEN 1 THEN '紧急' WHEN 2 THEN '高' WHEN 3 THEN '中' WHEN 4 THEN '低' ELSE '未知' END AS report_level_name, reporter_name, reporter_phone, reporter_id_card, report_time, incident_location, description, status, CASE status WHEN 1 THEN '待处理' WHEN 2 THEN '处理中' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN 4 THEN '已关闭' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name, handler_id, handler_name, handle_result, handle_time, attachments, remark, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_time FROM t_oa_police_report WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND deleted_flag = #{deletedFlag}

SELECT status, CASE status WHEN 1 THEN '待处理' WHEN 2 THEN '处理中' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN 4 THEN '已关闭' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_oa_police_report WHERE deleted_flag = #{deletedFlag} GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT MAX(report_number) FROM t_oa_police_report WHERE report_number LIKE CONCAT(#{datePrefix}, '%') AND deleted_flag = 0

SELECT incident_location FROM ( SELECT incident_location, MAX(create_time) as latest_time FROM t_oa_police_report WHERE incident_location IS NOT NULL AND incident_location != '' AND incident_location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND deleted_flag = #{deletedFlag} GROUP BY incident_location ORDER BY latest_time DESC LIMIT 10 ) AS unique_locations
